S.FORM: A azi e anu yau dawadsu si sanis e pibuRika peninaku si sanisika haw.
S.PHON: a a[z|r]i ə anu jau ɮawaɮsu si sanis ə piβuʁika pəninaku si sanisika haw
S.FORM: A azi e anu yau dawadsu si sanis e pibuRika peninaku si sanisika haw.
S.PHON: a a[z|r]i ə anu jau ɮawaɮsu si sanis ə piβuʁika pəninaku si sanisika haw
S.TRANSL: 阿姐,如果你有時間的話,削 ... 砍我的香蕉樹,削樹皮.
Sister, if you have time, bark ... cut my banana trees and bark (them).

S.FORM: I nengiti kinawsapaita ya mana qaya.
S.PHON: i nəŋiti kinawsapaita ja mana qaja
S.FORM: I nengiti kinawsapaita ya mana qaya.
S.PHON: i nəŋiti kinawsapaita ja mana qaja
S.TRANSL: 可以啊,我們兩個一起做.
Okay, we two can do it together.

S.FORM: A a kwa ya nani wanay ka.
S.PHON: a a kwa ja nani wanaj ka
S.FORM: A a kwa ya nani wanay ka.
S.PHON: a a kwa ja nani wanaj ka
S.TRANSL: 好啊,可是(我有客人).
Okay, but (I have guests).

S.FORM: ngidiku tenun nani wanay mRaynguiku smanis buqaRasiku.
S.PHON: ŋiɮiku tənun nani wanaj mʁajŋuiku smanis βuqaʁasiku
S.FORM: ngidiku tenun nani wanay mRaynguiku smanis buqaRasiku.
S.PHON: ŋiɮiku tənun nani wanaj mʁajŋuiku smanis βuqaʁasiku
S.TRANSL: 我想織布,可是我不會削樹皮,我很懶惰.
I want to weave, but I cannot bark (banana trees). I am lazy.

S.FORM: I niyana qabuqaRasan qanasanta si qawman XXXX mulpun tu usiq peninaan.
S.PHON: i nijana qaβuqaʁasan qanasanta si qawman **** murpun tu usiq pəninaan
S.FORM: I niyana qabuqaRasan qanasanta si qawman XXXX mulpun tu usiq peninaan.
S.PHON: i nijana qaβuqaʁasan qanasanta si qawman **** murpun tu usiq pəninaan
S.TRANSL: 不要懶惰,我們慢慢做,一定會做完一根香蕉.
Don't be lazy. If we do it slowly, we can definitely finish (barking) one banana.

S.FORM: A mRaynguiku usiq peninaan nani.
S.PHON: a mʁajŋuiku usiq pəninaan nani
S.FORM: A mRaynguiku usiq peninaan nani.
S.PHON: a mʁajŋuiku usiq pəninaan nani
S.TRANSL: 我不能做完一根香蕉.
I cannot (finish barking) one banana.

S.FORM: saqabianiku tu usiq penina nani.
S.PHON: saqaβianiku tu usiq pənina nani
S.FORM: saqabianiku tu usiq penina nani.
S.PHON: saqaβianiku tu usiq pənina nani
S.TRANSL: 我一天做一根香蕉.
I bark one banana tree in one day.

S.FORM: buqaRastiiku ya kelawkaway.
S.PHON: βuqaʁastiiku ja kərawkawaj
S.FORM: buqaRastiiku ya kelawkaway.
S.PHON: βuqaʁastiiku ja kərawkawaj
S.TRANSL: 我懶的做.
I am too lazy to work.

S.FORM: I qanasanta nani qawman mulpun.
S.PHON: i qanasanta nani qawman murpun
S.FORM: I qanasanta nani qawman mulpun.
S.PHON: i qanasanta nani qawman murpun
S.TRANSL: 慢慢做一定會做完.
We do it slowly, (and we can) definitely finish the job.

S.FORM: azu yau azu tantanuzanna mlalazuk.
S.PHON: a[z|r]u jau a[z|r]u tantanu[z|r]anna mrara[z|r]uk
S.FORM: azu yau azu tantanuzanna mlalazuk.
S.PHON: a[z|r]u jau a[z|r]u tantanu[z|r]anna mrara[z|r]uk
S.TRANSL: 好像有人在趕你要快點.
It's like there is someone who is chasing and hurrying you.

FORM.notes: source note: tepuq-an-ku lima-ku: 我割到我的手

S.FORM: A nayau saizi nani wanay smanisiku nani matepuq a limaku na mlizatiiku qaya ya.
S.PHON: a najau sai[z|r]i nani wanaj smanisiku nani matəpuq a rimaku na mri[z|r]atiiku qaja ja
S.FORM: A nayau saizi nani wanay smanisiku nani matepuq a limaku na mlizatiiku qaya ya.
S.PHON: a najau sai[z|r]i nani wanaj smanisiku nani matəpuq a rimaku na mri[z|r]atiiku qaja ja
S.TRANSL: 我割香蕉,割到我的手,我不敢做了.
(When) I barked banana trees, my hand was cut. I don't dare to (bark) again.

S.FORM: I paqanasaypa mlalalazuk saiza snayauan matepuq a lima.
S.PHON: i paqanasajpa mrarara[z|r]uk sai[z|r]a snajauan matəpuq a rima
S.FORM: I paqanasaypa mlalalazuk saiza snayauan matepuq a lima.
S.PHON: i paqanasajpa mrarara[z|r]uk sai[z|r]a snajauan matəpuq a rima
S.TRANSL: 慢慢做,快的話會割的手.
Do it slowly. If (we) do it in a hurry, (our) hands will be cut.

S.FORM: A mlalazukita saizi mdungutiita nani.
S.PHON: a mrara[z|r]ukita sai[z|r]i mɮuŋutiita nani
S.FORM: A mlalazukita saizi mdungutiita nani.
S.PHON: a mrara[z|r]ukita sai[z|r]i mɮuŋutiita nani
S.TRANSL: 我們要趕快.我們太慢了.
We had to hurry up. We were too slow.

S.FORM: qalalazukpaita zinku nani.
S.PHON: qarara[z|r]ukpaita [z|r]inku nani
S.FORM: qalalazukpaita zinku nani.
S.PHON: qarara[z|r]ukpaita [z|r]inku nani
S.TRANSL: 我想我們要快一點.
'We have to hurry up,' I thought.

S.FORM: timangu matepuqti limaku na mlizatiiku qaya sanis.
S.PHON: timaŋu matəpuqti rimaku na mri[z|r]atiiku qaja sanis
S.FORM: timangu matepuqti limaku na mlizatiiku qaya sanis.
S.PHON: timaŋu matəpuqti rimaku na mri[z|r]atiiku qaja sanis
S.TRANSL: 結果我的手被割到了.再也不敢削樹皮了.
It turned out that my hand was cut. I didn't dare to bark banana trees again.

S.FORM: I sukaw mliza.
S.PHON: i sukaw mri[z|r]a
S.FORM: I sukaw mliza.
S.PHON: i sukaw mri[z|r]a
S.TRANSL: 不要說不敢.
Don't flinch.

S.FORM: A nani I pawRatanta nani.
S.PHON: a nani i pawʁatanta nani
S.FORM: A nani I pawRatanta nani.
S.PHON: a nani i pawʁatanta nani
S.TRANSL: 我們一定要做.
We must manage to do it.

S.FORM: XXXX XXXX A sanisika aisu zinku.
S.PHON: **** **** a sanisika aisu [z|r]inku
S.FORM: XXXX XXXX A sanisika aisu zinku.
S.PHON: **** **** a sanisika aisu [z|r]inku
S.TRANSL: 我跟你說要削樹皮.
'Bark the banana trees,' I said to you.

S.FORM: ngidiku tenun nani mRaynguiku smanis I sinananam A zin na anemku a.
S.PHON: ŋiɮiku tənun nani mʁajŋuiku smanis i sinananam a [z|r]in na anəmku a
S.FORM: ngidiku tenun nani mRaynguiku smanis I sinananam A zin na anemku a.
S.PHON: ŋiɮiku tənun nani mʁajŋuiku smanis i sinananam a [z|r]in na anəmku a
S.TRANSL: 我想要織布,可是我想我不能削樹皮.
'I want to weave, but I cannot bark banana trees,' I think.

S.FORM: I qumni qaspeRanna.
S.PHON: i qumni qaspəʁanna
S.FORM: I qumni qaspeRanna.
S.PHON: i qumni qaspəʁanna
S.TRANSL: 你這樣什麼時候才會做?
When will you be able to do it?

S.FORM: nani mRaynguiku zinsu qumni qaspeRansu.
S.PHON: nani mʁajŋuiku [z|r]insu qumni qaspəʁansu
S.FORM: nani mRaynguiku zinsu qumni qaspeRansu.
S.PHON: nani mʁajŋuiku [z|r]insu qumni qaspəʁansu
S.TRANSL: 你說不會,那到底什麼時候才會?
You say you are unable to do it. When will you be able to do it?

S.FORM: A nayau mRaynguiku zinku na buqaRastiiku ya.
S.PHON: a najau mʁajŋuiku [z|r]inku na βuqaʁastiiku ja
S.FORM: A nayau mRaynguiku zinku na buqaRastiiku ya.
S.PHON: a najau mʁajŋuiku [z|r]inku na βuqaʁastiiku ja
S.TRANSL: 我想我不行.我很懶惰.
I think I can't. I am lazy.

S.FORM: si iza smanis nani I sukaw buqaRas A nayauti ya wawayku.
S.PHON: si i[z|r]a smanis nani i sukaw βuqaʁas a najauti ja wawajku
S.FORM: si iza smanis nani I sukaw buqaRas A nayauti ya wawayku.
S.PHON: si i[z|r]a smanis nani i sukaw βuqaʁas a najauti ja wawajku
S.TRANSL: 削樹皮的時候,我的動作就是這樣子.
(When it comes to) barking banana trees, I am like that.

S.FORM: I pawRatanta nani qawman wiyati sepaR.
S.PHON: i pawʁatanta nani qawman wijati səpaʁ
S.FORM: I pawRatanta nani qawman wiyati sepaR.
S.PHON: i pawʁatanta nani qawman wijati səpaʁ
S.TRANSL: 懶惰不好,我們一定要勉強做,慢慢就會了.
Being lazy is not good. We must manage to do it, and we'll be skilled gradually.

S.FORM: A en nayauti saizi anu amawaR si.
S.PHON: a ən najauti sai[z|r]i anu amawaʁ si
S.FORM: A en nayauti saizi anu amawaR si.
S.PHON: a ən najauti sai[z|r]i anu amawaʁ si
S.TRANSL: 好啊,以後.
Okay, afterwards

S.FORM: yau dawad si pawRataka smanis si.
S.PHON: jau ɮawaɮ si pawʁataka smanis si
S.FORM: yau dawad si pawRataka smanis si.
S.PHON: jau ɮawaɮ si pawʁataka smanis si
S.TRANSL: 有時間的話,勉強去削樹皮.
If I have time, I will manage to bark banana trees.

S.FORM: saqapian na usiq penina si quni zin na anemku qaya ya.
S.PHON: saqapian na usiq pənina si quni [z|r]in na anəmku qaja ja
S.FORM: saqapian na usiq penina si quni zin na anemku qaya ya.
S.PHON: saqapian na usiq pənina si quni [z|r]in na anəmku qaja ja
S.TRANSL: 我想,一天做一根也可以啊.
Barking one banana tree in one day is acceptable, I think.

S.FORM: I en nayauanta saqawqa yau sepaR.
S.PHON: i ən najauanta saqawqa jau səpaʁ
S.FORM: I en nayauanta saqawqa yau sepaR.
S.PHON: i ən najauanta saqawqa jau səpaʁ
S.TRANSL: 我們這樣子,一定會的.
If we do so, we will definitely become skilled.

S.FORM: XXXX Raynguiku Raynguiku zinta zinsu haw Raynguti X waliwisu buqaRas.
S.PHON: **** ʁajŋuiku ʁajŋuiku [z|r]inta [z|r]insu haw ʁajŋuti * wariwisu βuqaʁas
S.FORM: XXXX Raynguiku Raynguiku zinta zinsu haw Raynguti X waliwisu buqaRas.
S.PHON: **** ʁajŋuiku ʁajŋuiku [z|r]inta [z|r]insu haw ʁajŋuti * wariwisu βuqaʁas
S.TRANSL: 你一直說不會,結果就真的不會,而且也懶的做.
If you keep saying 'I can't, I can't,' you will be incapable and lazy.

S.FORM: XXXX A mlizaqiku tmenun.
S.PHON: **** a mri[z|r]aqiku tmənun
S.FORM: XXXX A mlizaqiku tmenun.
S.PHON: **** a mri[z|r]aqiku tmənun
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡編織.
I like weaving.

S.FORM: I wi X wi sepapaR.
S.PHON: i wi * wi səpapaʁ
S.FORM: I wi X wi sepapaR.
S.PHON: i wi * wi səpapaʁ
S.TRANSL: 一直做,就一定會做.
If we keep doing, we will be skilled.

FORM.notes: source note: nunu-an-ku kelawkaway: 我每天工作

S.FORM: nunuanta nani.
S.PHON: nunuanta nani
S.FORM: nunuanta nani.
S.PHON: nunuanta nani
S.TRANSL: 我們每天做.
We do it every day.

S.FORM: wiyati sepaR nani.
S.PHON: wijati səpaʁ nani
S.FORM: wiyati sepaR nani.
S.PHON: wijati səpaʁ nani
S.TRANSL: 就會做.
(We) will be skilled.

S.FORM: maiti maytis tu qatepuqan.
S.PHON: maiti majtis tu qatəpuqan
S.FORM: maiti maytis tu qatepuqan.
S.PHON: maiti majtis tu qatəpuqan
S.TRANSL: 就不會怕被割到.
(We) won't be afraid of being cut.

S.FORM: A ngidiku tenun nani.
S.PHON: a ŋiɮiku tənun nani
S.FORM: A ngidiku tenun nani.
S.PHON: a ŋiɮiku tənun nani
S.TRANSL: 我想要編織.
I want to weave.

FORM.notes: source note: s<en>anis-an: 割好的香蕉樹皮 | source note: qelizen: 用割好的香蕉樹皮所做綁成的線圈

S.FORM: mai tu senanisan nani mlikenengtiiku a nayau a wawayku buqaRasay.
S.PHON: mai tu sənanisan nani mrikənəŋtiiku a najau a wawajku βuqaʁasaj
S.FORM: mai tu senanisan nani mlikenengtiiku a nayau a wawayku buqaRasay.
S.PHON: mai tu sənanisan nani mrikənəŋtiiku a najau a wawajku βuqaʁasaj
S.TRANSL: (可是)沒有割好的香蕉樹皮,我就休息,我就是這樣懶惰的人.
(But) I don't have the peeled banana bark, (so) I take a rest. I am this kind of lazy person.

S.FORM: I malmesiku smanis nani Raynguiku tmnun.
S.PHON: i marməsiku smanis nani ʁajŋuiku tmnun
S.FORM: I malmesiku smanis nani Raynguiku tmnun.
S.PHON: i marməsiku smanis nani ʁajŋuiku tmnun
S.TRANSL: 我認真割香蕉樹皮,(可是)我不會織布.
I am earnest in barking banana trees, (but) I cannot weave.

S.FORM: buqaw pasyani smani.
S.PHON: βuqaw pasjani smani
S.FORM: buqaw pasyani smani.
S.PHON: βuqaw pasjani smani
S.TRANSL: 看不清楚,線往哪裡我不知道.
I have poor eyesight. I don't know where the lines go.

S.FORM: A mlizaqiku tmnun nani.
S.PHON: a mri[z|r]aqiku tmnun nani
S.FORM: A mlizaqiku tmnun nani.
S.PHON: a mri[z|r]aqiku tmnun nani
S.TRANSL: 我喜歡編織.
I like weaving.

FORM.notes: source note: s<en>anis-an: 割好的香蕉樹皮 | source note: qelizen: 用割好的香蕉樹皮所做綁成的線圈

S.FORM: mai tu senanisan tu qelizen nani mlikenengtiiku zinku a.
S.PHON: mai tu sənanisan tu qəri[z|r]ən nani mrikənəŋtiiku [z|r]inku a
S.FORM: mai tu senanisan tu qelizen nani mlikenengtiiku zinku a.
S.PHON: mai tu sənanisan tu qəri[z|r]ən nani mrikənəŋtiiku [z|r]inku a
S.TRANSL: (可是)我沒有削好的香蕉樹皮和香蕉樹皮繞成的線圈,我想我就會休息.
(But) I don't have peeled banana bark and the coil of banana bark, so I will take a rest, I think.

S.FORM: I Raynugiku tmnun buqaw.
S.PHON: i ʁajnugiku tmnun βuqaw
S.FORM: I Raynugiku tmnun buqaw.
S.PHON: i ʁajnugiku tmnun βuqaw
S.TRANSL: 我不會織布,(因為)看不清楚.
I cannot weave, (because) I have poor eyesight.

S.FORM: pasiyasiyaniti mngiwit.
S.PHON: pasijasijaniti mŋiwit
S.FORM: pasiyasiyaniti mngiwit.
S.PHON: pasijasijaniti mŋiwit
S.TRANSL: (線)會歪一邊.
(The lines) would be lopsided.

S.FORM: A mulpun mulpunti X.
S.PHON: a murpun murpunti *
S.FORM: A mulpun mulpunti X.
S.PHON: a murpun murpunti *
S.TRANSL: 做完了沒有?
Have you finished?

S.FORM: I X mul maipama mulpun dadusapama nazaupama.
S.PHON: i * mur maipama murpun ɮaɮusapama na[z|r]aupama
S.FORM: I X mul maipama mulpun dadusapama nazaupama.
S.PHON: i * mur maipama murpun ɮaɮusapama na[z|r]aupama
S.TRANSL: 還沒有,才完成一半,這麼長而已.
Not yet. I have finished only half of it. This long.

FORM.notes: source note: 編織的工作場所在學校

S.FORM: A en I azasanku temawaR ta taqsian nani.
S.PHON: a ən i a[z|r]asanku təmawaʁ ta taqsian nani
S.FORM: A en I azasanku temawaR ta taqsian nani.
S.PHON: a ən i a[z|r]asanku təmawaʁ ta taqsian nani
S.TRANSL: 我明天要帶去學校.
I will take it to school tomorrow.

S.FORM: A unay nitenun siRab.
S.PHON: a unaj nitənun siʁaβ
S.FORM: A unay nitenun siRab.
S.PHON: a unaj nitənun siʁaβ
S.TRANSL: 這是你昨天做布的嗎?
Is this what you had for weaving yesterday?

S.FORM: I en.
S.PHON: i ən
S.FORM: I en.
S.PHON: i ən
S.TRANSL: 嗯.
Yes.

S.FORM: A Ray nani bulaiku tata zinku nani.
S.PHON: a ʁaj nani βuraiku tata [z|r]inku nani
S.FORM: A Ray nani bulaiku tata zinku nani.
S.PHON: a ʁaj nani βuraiku tata [z|r]inku nani
S.TRANSL: 我說,給我那個.
'Give that to me,' said I.

FORM.notes: source note: midayan-an-ku kelawkaway: 我隨便做

S.FORM: anu XXXX si I mlalibed paqsidap A midayan qaya.
S.PHON: anu **** si i mrariβəɮ paqsiɮap a miɮajan qaja
S.FORM: anu XXXX si I mlalibed paqsidap A midayan qaya.
S.PHON: anu **** si i mrariβəɮ paqsiɮap a miɮajan qaja
S.TRANSL: 隨便啦.
It doesn't matter.

S.FORM: anu yauti ya nitenun na tinaku anu zinnati na sunis.
S.PHON: anu jauti ja nitənun na tinaku anu [z|r]innati na sunis
S.FORM: anu yauti ya nitenun na tinaku anu zinnati na sunis.
S.PHON: anu jauti ja nitənun na tinaku anu [z|r]innati na sunis
S.TRANSL: 小孩說,我媽媽織布的做完了.
The child said, 'My mother has finished what is for weaving.'

S.FORM: I sanisakita zasuay si.
S.PHON: i sanisakita [z|r]asuaj si
S.FORM: I sanisakita zasuay si.
S.PHON: i sanisakita [z|r]asuaj si
S.TRANSL: 我們要割你的.
We'll bark yours.

S.FORM: A wanay buqaRasiku.
S.PHON: a wanaj βuqaʁasiku
S.FORM: A wanay buqaRasiku.
S.PHON: a wanaj βuqaʁasiku
S.TRANSL: 我很懶惰.
I am lazy.

S.FORM: I nutuzikati tenunika qawqaita sepaR.
S.PHON: i nutu[z|r]ikati tənunika qawqaita səpaʁ
S.FORM: I nutuzikati tenunika qawqaita sepaR.
S.PHON: i nutu[z|r]ikati tənunika qawqaita səpaʁ
S.TRANSL: 能夠自己繞香蕉線圈和編織,比較好.
If we can coil the lines peeled off from banana bark and weave on our own, it would be better.

W.TRANSL: 綁香蕉線-處焦.祈使=完成

FORM.notes: source annotation: subuq就是用從香蕉樹皮割下的線所做成的背袋

S.FORM: mduday tengengti unay sukaw midayan sasubuqantati.
S.PHON: mɮuɮaj təŋəŋti unaj sukaw miɮajan sasuβuqantati
S.FORM: mduday tengengti unay sukaw midayan sasubuqantati.
S.PHON: mɮuɮaj təŋəŋti unaj sukaw miɮajan sasuβuqantati
S.TRANSL: 沒有對齊,又黑,不好,自己用來當背包就好.
That is untidy and black. It's bad. We leave it for our own use as a bag.

W.TRANSL: 未來-香蕉編的背包-處焦-1IPL.屬格=完成

S.FORM: A midayan zinku ya.
S.PHON: a miɮajan [z|r]inku ja
S.FORM: A midayan zinku ya.
S.PHON: a miɮajan [z|r]inku ja

'It doesn't matter,' said I.
